extraction.notes: Free excerpt of a commercial English translation on Zakon.hr. The full document is offered only for purchase and was not obtained. Text-file page numbers are PDF page numbers. Only claims on access to employment for EU workers in Croatia were extracted (RI-FMW-001, LIM-0026). Pass 1 does not assign issues. Publication date is the year of the OG 74/13 amendment marked in the text; the page gives no date for the translation. Quotes keep the stray spaces of the converted text.

items.stated_text: – Directive 2004/3 8/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 29 April 2004 on the right of citizens of the Union and their family members to move and reside freely within the territory of the Member States; (Official Journal No. L 158 of 30 April 2004),
items.summary: The Act lists Directive 2004/38/EC on free movement and residence of Union citizens among the directives it transposes.
items.extraction_note: Allowed by logged exception LIM-0027 (comparator documents from 2007 onwards on RI-FMW-001 for Croatia). Unofficial English text on a private publisher’s page that states it is not an official source. Text as marked OG 74/13; only the contents and Articles 1 to 4 are free, and the full text is sold, so Chapter X was not read here. Item in the list introduced by “This Act transposes into the legislation of the Republic of Croatia the following directives:”. The space in “2004/3 8” is as printed.

pass2.classification_note: country_response: Statement that the Act aligns with Directive 2004/38/EC. Unofficial English text; says nothing itself on labour access beyond this.

items.stated_text: A national of a Member State of the European Economic Area (hereinafter the EEA) means an alien having the nationality of one of the EEA Member States.
items.summary: The Act defines an EEA national as an alien with the nationality of an EEA Member State.
